book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Yɨɨsu arabhuuribhwa igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ
Rusikʉ rʉmwɨ Yɨɨsu aarɨ mwihekaaru ariija abhaatʉ igʉrʉ wɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu ya Mungu. Neho abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, abhiija bhi imigirʉ, na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi bhakamwizɨra,
bhakamubhuurya, “Ganʉ okokora, ʉrakora kwa bhʉnajakɨ? Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ akʉhɨɨrɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhʉnʉ?”
Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Na niinyɨ nɨrabhabhuurya ringʼana rɨmwɨ. Mʉmbʉʉrɨrɨ,
ʉbhʉnaja bhwa Yoohana bhwʉ ʉkʉbhatiiza bhʉkarwa kwa Mungu kisha kʉbhaatʉ?”
Bhakiibhuurya abheene kobheene bharabhuga, “Tʉraabhugɨ, ‘Bhʉkarwa mwisaarʉ,’ aratubhuurya, ‘Ndora mʉtamwisiriiryɨ?’
Na tʉraabhugɨ, ‘Bhʉkarwa kʉbhaatʉ,’ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharatotema amabhwɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhʉʉsi bhariisirirya kʉbha Yoohana aarɨ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri.”
Akʉmara, bhakamʉgarukirya, “Tʉtɨɨzɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ bhʉkarwa hayi.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Na niinyɨ nɨtakʉbhabhʉʉrɨra nɨrakora amangʼana ganʉ kwa bhʉnajakɨ.”
Ekerenjo cha abharimi abhabhɨ
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉbhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ ekerenjo. Akabhuga, “Kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ, wʉnʉ aahambirɨ ɨmɨzabhiibhu mʉmʉgʉndʉ gwazɨ, akakʉʉdishirya abharimi. Ewe akaja icharʉ ɨkɨndɨ, akamara iyo sikʉ nzaru.

Na hanʉ zisikʉ zo okogesa zaahikirɨ, akatʉma mbʉʉsa waazɨ kʉbharimi bhayo, korereke bhamohe ribhaara ryazɨ ryi ibhyakurya, agarʉkɨ naryʉ kʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ. Nawe, hanʉ mbʉʉsa aahikirɨ, abharimi bhayo bhakamotema na bhakamoheebha mabhoko bhʉʉha.
“Wʉ ʉmʉgʉndʉ, akatʉma mbʉʉsa ʉwʉndɨ. Nawe wʉʉsi bhakamotema na komokora kɨbhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu, akʉmara bhakamoheebha mabhoko bhʉʉha.
Akatʉma mbʉʉsa wa katatʉ. Wuyo wʉʉsi bhakamʉnyahaara, bhakamoheebha.
“Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, wʉ ʉmʉgʉndʉ akabhuga, ‘Nangʉ, nekorebhwɨ? Orogendo rʉnʉ, nɨratʉma umwana waanɨ ʉmʉsɨɨgwa, hamwɨ ewe bharamʉsʉʉka.’
“Nawe, hanʉ abharimi bharya bhaamʉrʉʉzɨ, bhakarwaza abheene kobheene bharabhuga, ‘Wʉnʉ newe ʉmʉgabhi wʉ ʉmʉgʉndʉ gʉnʉ. Tumwitɨ, korereke ɨgabhʉ yaazɨ ɨbhɨ iyɨɨtʉ.’
Bhakamuhurucha igʉtʉ wʉ ʉmʉgʉndʉ, bhakamwita.” Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, wʉ ʉmʉgʉndʉ arabhakorabhwɨ abharimi bhayo?
Araaza na kubhiita abharimi bhayo, na kʉbhaha abharimi abhandɨ ʉmʉgʉndʉ guyo!” Hanʉ abhaatʉ bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, bhakabhuga, “Gayo gatakʉtʉrɨkana ze!”
Yɨɨsu akabhakandikija amɨɨsʉ, akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ! Amaandɨkʉ ganʉ gana nzobhoorokɨ?

content.text: neryo rɨbhɨɨrɨ riibhwɨ rikʉrʉ rya rusizʉ.’

content: Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉbha agwiriirɨ riibhwɨ riyo, arabhunɨkabhunɨka. Na wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ riibhwɨ riyo rɨraamugwɨrɨ, rɨramusha bhoseeseka.”
Abhiija bhi imigirʉ bhayo na abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, bhakamenya kʉbha, ekerenjo kiyo nebho kɨkʉgambɨra. Bhakeenda kumugwata hayohayo, nawe bhakʉʉbhaha riribhita rya abhaatʉ.
Yɨɨsu arabhuuribhwa igʉrʉ wʉ ʉkʉrɨha rigʉʉti

Kʉgayo, abhakʉrʉ bha Abhayaahudi, bhakabha bharabhuuririrya Yɨɨsu. Bhakatʉma abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhiikʉriryɨ nɨ‑bha amaheene korereke bhagwatyɨ Yɨɨsu kʉmangʼana ganʉ akʉgamba, na kumuhira kumwanangwa wi Ikiruumi.
Nangʉ, abhaatʉ bhayo bhakamubhuurya, “Umwija, tʉmɨnyirɨ ʉragamba na kutwija amaragɨrɨra ga amaheene. Ʉtakʉdɨɨrɨɨra ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ, nawe uriija kwa bhʉʉsi, ɨnzɨra ya Mungu ku kutuna eheene.
Kʉrɨngʼaana ni imigirʉ ja Musa, toreenderwa kʉrɨha rigʉʉti kwa Kaisaari,
kisha zɨyi?”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akamenya omotego gwabhʉ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra,
“Monyeereche rizenzere. Ipicha yɨnʉ ni iriina rɨnʉ, ni‑bhya wɨɨwɨ?” Bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨ‑bhya Kaisaari.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nangʉ, bhya Kaisaari, mohe Kaisaari, na bhya Mungu, mohe Mungu.”
Rigarukirya riyo, rɨkabharuguurya bhʉkʉngʼu, rɨkagirya bhakirɨ. Bhakatamwa kʉmʉhaatya kʉmangʼana ganʉ aagambirɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ.
Yɨɨsu ariija igʉrʉ wu ukuryʉka abhaku
Akʉmara Abhasadukaayo
bhanʉ bhahaabhuga abhaku bhatakuryʉka, bhakaaza kwa Yɨɨsu. Bhakabhuga,
“Umwija, mumigirʉ Musa akatwandɨkɨra kʉbha, arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ akuurɨ, na atigirɨ ʉmʉkari waazɨ ataana umwana, umuhiiri waazɨ agabhɨ umukwirwa wuyo, amwibhʉrɨrɨ abhaana umwabhʉ wʉnʉ akuurɨ.
Mmbe, bhaareho abhahiiri muhungatɨ bhanʉ bhiibhwirwɨ ɨnda yɨmwɨ. Umwana we embere akakwɨra ʉmʉkari, akakwa aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kwibhʉra mwana.
Umunyi waazɨ wa kabhɨrɨ, [akagabha umukwirwa wuyo, akʉmara akakwa, atamwibhwiryɨ umwana].
Wa katatʉ wʉʉsi akamʉgabha, akakwa. Ɨkabhabhu kwa bhʉʉsi muhungatɨ, bhakakwɨra ʉmʉkari wuyo, bhakakwa bhakɨɨrɨ kumwibhurya abhaana.
Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, ʉmʉkari wuyo wʉʉsi akakwa.
Mmbe tʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, urusikʉ rʉnʉ rʉkʉgambwa kʉbha abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhararyʉka, umukwirwa wuyo arabha mʉka wɨɨwɨ? Muhungatɨ bhayo bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bhamukwɨrirɨ!”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Abhaatʉ bha ribhaga rɨnʉ bharakwɨra na kukwɨrwa.
Nawe, bhanʉ Mungu arʉʉzɨ bhareenderwa kuryukurwa mʉbhaku na kwikara kʉʉsɨ iihya, bhayo bhatakukwɨra naabha kukwɨrwa.
Na bhatakʉtʉra kukwa naatu, kʉ kʉbha bharabha chɨmbu bhamaraika. Bharabha abhaana bha Mungu, kʉ kʉbha bharyukwirwɨ mʉbhaku.
“Nʉʉrʉ Musa akahiitya abhaatʉ kʉbha abhaku bhararyʉka mʉmaandɨkʉ ganʉ aandikirɨ igʉrʉ wi ikitutuuna kɨnʉ chakirɨ omorero, akabhuga kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu ‘Newe Mungu wa Abhurahaamu, Iisaka na Yaakobho.’
Kʉgayo, nʉʉrʉ bhatatʉ bhayo bhaarɨ bhakuurɨ sikʉ nzaru, Mungu akabhuga ebho nɨ‑bhahʉru kwewe! Abhaku na abhahʉru, bhʉʉsi nɨ‑bhahʉru mʉmɨɨsʉ gaazɨ.”
Abhiija abhandɨ bhi imigirʉ bhakabhuga, “Umwija, ʉgambirɨ bhwaheene!”
Kwɨma ribhaga riyo, bhakʉʉbhaha kubhuurya Yɨɨsu amabhuurya agandɨ.
Yɨɨsu arabhuurya Abhafarisaayo igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ
Nawe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya abhiija bhayo, “Kwakɨ abhaatʉ bhahaabhuga, Kiriisitʉ ni‑mwana wʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi?
Daudi umwene, mʉkɨtabhʉ cha Zabhuri, akabhuga,

content.text: kuhika hanʉ nɨkʉtʉʉra abhabhisa bhaazʉ iyaasɨ wa amagʉrʉ gaazʉ.” ’

content: Arɨɨbhɨ Daudi arabhɨrɨkɨra Kiriisitʉ, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ,’ nangʉ Kiriisitʉ aratʉrabhwɨ kʉbha umwana waazɨ naatu?”
Yɨɨsu araragɨrɨra ukwiyangarɨra na abhiija bhi imigirʉ
Hanʉ abhaatʉ bha riribhita bhaarɨ bhariitegeerera, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ,

“Mwiyangarɨrɨ na abhiija bhi imigirʉ ja Musa. Bhanʉ bhasɨɨgirɨ kogenda kʉnzɨra bhiibhʉhirɨ zɨkanzʉ zaabhʉ na kʉkɨɨribhwa kubhusuuku mometeera. Na mʉmarwazɨrʉ, bhahaasɨɨga kwikara kubhitumbɨ bhye embere. Na arɨɨbhɨ bharaarikirwɨ kʉzɨnyangi, bhahaasɨɨga kwikara hanʉ abhakangati bhiikɨɨrɨ.

Bhahaaruusha abhakwirwa ebhegero bhyabhʉ. Na bhariikorya nɨ‑bhaatʉ bhagʉrʉrʉku kʉ kʉsabha amasabhi marɨɨhu bhʉkʉngʼu korereke bhiiyeerekenʼye kwa abhaatʉ. Kurusikʉ rwɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ, abhaatʉ bhayo bharahaabhwa ɨtɨnɨrʉ kʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu.”

footnotes.text: Riibhwɨ rikʉrʉ rya rusizʉ ryarɨ rereenderwa kuryʉmbaka rya Abhayaahudi. Rɨkagwatanʼya nyiki ibhɨrɨ na kugwatɨrɨra inyumba ngima. Rora Zabhuri 118:22.
